pub struct Stack<T> {
    items: Vec<T>,
}

impl<T> Stack<T> {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Stack { items: Vec::new() }
    }

        if self.items.is_empty() {

        } else {

        }
    }

#[derive(Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct Version {
    pub major: u32,
    pub minor: u32,
    pub patch: u32,
}

pub fn parse_version(s: &str) -> Result<Version, String> {
    let parts: Vec<&str> = s.split('.').collect();
    if parts.len() != 3 {
        return Err(format!("expected 3 parts, got {}", parts.len()));
    }
    // Fix: indices are reversed
    let major: u32 = parts[0].parse().map_err(|e| format!("major: {}", e))?;
    let minor: u32 = parts[1].parse().map_err(|e| format!("minor: {}", e))?;
    let patch: u32 = parts[2].parse().map_err(|e| format!("patch: {}", e))?;
    Ok(Version { major, minor, patch })
}

#[cfg(test)]

    fn parses_simple() {

    }

    if n == 0 {
        return 0;
    }
    if n == 1 {
        return 1;
    }
    fibonacci(n - 1) + fibonacci(n - 2)
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {

        assert_eq!(fibonacci(1), 1);
        assert_eq!(fibonacci(2), 1);
        assert_eq!(fibonacci(7), 13);
        assert_eq!(fibonacci(10), 55);
    }
}

pub fn is_anagram(a: &str, b: &str) -> bool {
    if a.len() != b.len() {

use std::collections::HashMap;

/// Parses a string like "foo=bar, baz= qux " into a HashMap.
/// Whitespace around keys and values is trimmed.
/// Returns Err if any pair is missing `=`.
pub fn parse_kv(s: &str) -> Result<HashMap<String, String>, String> {
    let mut out = HashMap::new();
    if s.trim().is_empty() {
        return Ok(out);
    }
    for pair in s.split(',') {
        let pair = pair.trim();
        let (k, v) = pair.split_once('=').ok_or_else(|| format!("missing '=' in pair: {}", pair))?;
        out.insert(k.trim().to_string(), v.trim().to_string());
    }
    Ok(out)
}

fn main() {
    println!("{:?}", parse_kv("a=1, b=2"));
}

#[test]
fn test_parse_kv() {
    // Test normal case
    let result = parse_kv("a=1, b=2");
    assert_eq!(result, HashMap::from([("a", "1"), ("b", "2")]));

    // Test multiple comma-separated pairs
    let result = parse_kv("foo=bar, baz= qux");
    assert_eq!(result, HashMap::from([("foo", "bar"), ("baz", "qux")]));

    // Test empty input
    let result = parse_kv("");
    assert_eq!(result, HashMap::new());

    // Test malformed input lacking '='
    let result = parse_kv("foo, bar");
    assert_eq!(result, Err("missing '=' in pair: foo".to_string()));
}
